invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of HoodieMergeHandleFactory.create, which is expected to be non-null unless an exception is thrown.
The fileId parameter is directly passed to the factory method, so the returned handle should have the same fileId.
The partitionPath parameter is passed to the factory, so the handle result should reflect this value.
The instantTime parameter is passed to the factory for the result handle.
